parts.note_add: Catalogue 3300A-1 (S-005 Engine-Chassis p.97) lists it as 'plate, hub/disk' 8871-33-251A, qty 2, with the hub cap 0419-33-071, set cover 0259-33-049, tab washer 8531-33-043 and nut 0259-33-042. S-038 p.8 gives the 1982 figures: 18 mm new, 17 mm limit, 0.1 mm run-out, the same as SP-113. Atkins sells a new rotor as 8871-33-251B for 79-83 (69.25 USD, 912 in stock 2026-09-27); the 84-85 rotor FA54-33-251B is a different part. Hub and disc come off as one unit (S-002 p.9-5): cap, split pin, nut lock, adjusting nut, washer, outer bearing.

Tapered roller bearings, inner 8545-33-047 (Atkins 32.95 USD, sold as 8545-33-047-MV, 79-85) and outer B002-33-075 (Atkins 17.75 USD, 79-83 only; page says it replaces 8531-33-075 and also fits the 84-85 GLC). The 84-85 RX-7 outer bearing is 1391-33-075 and larger (rx7club thread), so 84-85 listings do not fit. No Timken/Koyo cross found in two searches. Repack with lithium NLGI No.2 and set the preload with a spring scale on a hub bolt (S-002 p.9-6); the 1982 figure is 4.5-6.5 N at the wheel bolt (S-038 p.8).

Atkins sells the seal 1312-33-065 at 8.50 USD (in stock 2026-09-27), cross-references 0398-33-065 and FA54-33-065, fits all 79-85 RX-7 and some 85-87 626. The 1985 manual calls it the grease seal, fitted behind the inner bearing (S-002 p.9-5). No National/SKF cross found; Timken 1975S is for 86-91 only.

Catalogue 'pad, sub set' 8871-49-280A, one set per car (S-005 Engine-Chassis p.97). Mazda's set is no longer available; Atkins sells an OEM-quality set as FA57-49-280 for 79-85 12A at 45.00 USD (2026-09-27), and PartsGeek lists Raybestos SGD76 for 79-85 front (search result only, page blocked). Lining is 9 mm new and 1 mm limit (S-038 p.8). Replace all four pads together, never mix types, and grease the caliper mounting pin and attaching bolt with the grease in the pad kit (S-002 p.11-5).

Single-piston floating caliper, the lower attaching bolt comes out and the body pivots up on the upper pin to change pads (S-002 p.11-4). No new Mazda caliper found: Atkins' 79-85 caliper category holds only a 1979 mounting support, and Cardone lists a remanufactured caliper 19-644 for 81-85 RX-7 (side not stated, pricing behind a login). Overhaul is with seal kit 8341-49-240 (in stock at Atkins and Mazdatrix) and the piston comes out with compressed air against a wood block (S-002 p.11-6). The 1983 Mitchell brake article (src-mitchell-1983-brakes) is downloaded to 01-REFERENCE/model/library/datasheets/PT050/.
Catalogue 'cap, hub' 0419-33-071, qty 2 (S-005 Engine-Chassis p.97); 'grease cap' in the 1985 manual, first off when the hub comes apart (S-002 p.9-5). No listing found (one search).
'Mounting adapter' in the 1985 structural view, item 11, bolted to the knuckle; the caliper support and pad clips hang on it (S-002 p.11-4). No listing found.

Removed by blowing compressed air into the fluid hole against a wood block; scoring or rust means a new piston or caliper, minor marks polish out with crocus cloth (S-002 p.11-6). Bore is 50.80 mm (S-038 p.8).

Mazdatrix sells the bleeder 0233-33-691 (79-92 single-piston front) at 10.11 USD, in stock 2026-09-27. Bleed with a tube into a jar of fluid, front and rear circuits separately, reservoir kept at least 3/4 full (S-002 p.11-24).
Catalogue 'pin' 8341-33-699, qty 2, sold on its own; 8341-49-290A is 'all the pins' (S-005 Engine-Chassis p.97). Grease from the pad kit goes on the pin at every pad change (S-002 p.11-5).

One kit does both front calipers and includes the grease: Atkins 49.95 USD, Mazdatrix 45.71 USD, both in stock 2026-09-27. The kit's two greases (orange and red) go where the 1985 figure shows; piston seal and dust boot are never reused (S-002 p.11-7).

Mazdatrix lists the 81-85 caliper boot kits as discontinued by Mazda (2026-09-27); Atkins' seal-kit page refers to a companion boot kit but no listing was checked. Boot and retainer come off first in the 1985 overhaul (S-002 p.11-6).

Atkins sells the hardware kit 8341-49-290A for 79-85 12A at 69.99 USD, in stock 2026-09-27; the catalogue says it carries all the pins (S-005 Engine-Chassis p.97). The anti-rattle spring and shims come out with the pads (S-002 p.11-5).

Catalogue page 4300A-1 (S-005 Engine-Chassis p.108, sheet 1-N9) read from the image: brake pedal FA01-43-030 '81 M/T S and GS and FA03-43-030 '81 A/T S and GS, both without control switch and both only to FB331 500001-521855; FA02-43-303 M/T GSL and FA05-43-030 A/T GSL, with control switch, no serial limit. The only A/T pedal listed past serial 521855 is FA05-43-030, so a 1982 A/T GS most likely carries it - check the pedal on the car. Suspended type; height is set by turning the stop light switch in its lock nut, free travel by the push rod lock nut (S-002 p.11-25).
Catalogue 'bushing, pedal' 1015-46-085, qty 2 on A/T (4 on M/T, which has the clutch pedal too), item 43022 (S-005 Engine-Chassis p.108). No listing found.

Catalogue 'pad, pedal' 0225-43-028A qty 1 on A/T; M/T cars use 8871-43-028A x2 (S-005 Engine-Chassis p.108). The same number is still sold as a B2200 pedal pad by Mazda dealers (Jim Ellis listing, page not opened).
Catalogue 'rubber, stopper' B001-43-029, qty 2 on A/T, 3 on M/T (S-005 Engine-Chassis p.108). No listing found.

Catalogue 'valve, brake pipe' FA07-43-900 on both the drum (S, GS) and disc (GSL) piping pages for '81 and '82; the '83 GSL takes FA48-43-900 (S-005 Engine-Chassis p.111-112). The 1985 manual calls it the differential proportioning valve, sits it on the front pipe between master cylinder and the front and rear lines, and says to match the identification mark on the body when reconnecting the pipes (S-002 p.11-2, 11-26). Owners describe one inlet from the master cylinder and outlets marked F (front) and an arrow (rear), a large hex cap with a copper washer over the piston (rx7club threads). No split point or ratio found in any source.

Atkins sells GA02-43-980 for 81-83 12A at 49.95 USD, in stock 2026-09-27, same hose both sides, two per car. Mazdatrix lists GA02-43-980 as discontinued by Mazda and sells DOT stainless kits instead (81-85 drum 14524-DOT, 68.64 USD). Union torque 25-35 N·m (S-038 p.10). Never let the caliper hang on the hose (S-002 p.9-5).

Catalogue 'hose no.1, flexible' FA07-43-820, one per car on the drum-brake piping (S-005 Engine-Chassis p.111); mazda-parts.com still lists FA07-43-820 as a flex hose (page blocked, from the search index). Mazdatrix's 81-85 drum DOT stainless kit 14524-DOT (68.64 USD) replaces it with the front hoses. Union torque 25-35 N·m (S-038 p.10).
Catalogue 'pipe, brake-front' FA07-43-360, item 45250, master cylinder to the valve (S-005 Engine-Chassis p.111). No listing found; union nut 13-22 N·m (S-038 p.10).
'81 and '82 models only; the '83 pipe is FA42-45-280 (S-005 Engine-Chassis p.111). No listing found; union nut 13-22 N·m (S-038 p.10).
Catalogue item 45320, no year split (S-005 Engine-Chassis p.111). No listing found; union nut 13-22 N·m (S-038 p.10).

The seven 8595-43-609 protectors are listed for '81 and '82 to FB331 610655; the disc-brake page uses six with spacers 1114-43-608B and cushions 1114-43-609A (S-005 Engine-Chassis p.111-112). No listing found; union nut 13-22 N·m (S-038 p.10).
Catalogue item 45360A, the same number on the drum and disc piping pages (S-005 Engine-Chassis p.111-112). No listing found; union nut 13-22 N·m (S-038 p.10).
Drum-brake axle pipe; the disc-brake page uses FA18-43-650 instead (S-005 Engine-Chassis p.111-112). No listing found; union nut 13-22 N·m (S-038 p.10).
Drum-brake axle pipe; the disc-brake page uses FA18-43-660 instead (S-005 Engine-Chassis p.111-112). No listing found; union nut 13-22 N·m (S-038 p.10).
